title: Microplastic extraction from water, sediment, soil, and atmospheric deposition samples
author: Yu, Lisa
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Spike (optional) and sieve sample
steps.instruction: If desired, spike the sample with known amounts of microplastic standards to assess recovery, then sieve the sample sequentially through a 500 µm sieve and collect the retained material on a 20 µm sieve.

substeps.instruction: Add microplastic standards to the sample (optional).
Pass the sample through a 500 µm sieve.
Collect material that passes onto a 20 µm sieve.

steps.title: Density separation with ZnCl₂
steps.instruction: Perform density separation by adding a 60 % ZnCl₂ solution to the sieved sample to float microplastics.

steps.title: Remove organic matter (Fenton oxidation)
steps.instruction: Apply the Fenton oxidation reaction to the floated material to oxidize and remove organic matter from microplastic surfaces.

steps.title: Manually count microplastics
steps.instruction: Visually inspect the treated sample and manually count the microplastic particles.

steps.title: Identify particles with LDIR
steps.instruction: Characterize and identify the counted microplastic particles using Laser Direct Infrared (LDIR) spectroscopy.
